identity_rule: Canonical identity is version + exact byte SHA256 + decoded dimensions. The historical .png filename is not an encoding guarantee.
encoding_rule: Detect image encoding from magic bytes. PNG uses its signature/IHDR; JPEG uses SOI and SOF dimensions. Do not reject the canonical bytes merely because their encoding does not match the filename extension.
transcode_rule: Never re-encode or transcode the owner source just to make its extension match; re-encoding changes the canonical SHA256.
progress_rule: Existing merged geography inputs already cryptographically bound to this SHA may continue to support later layers. New raw-pixel extraction or new pixel-to-render fidelity metrics require the exact canonical bytes to be available to the validating environment.
